news.title: Junior Madi Russ makes her mark through leadership, service and school spirit
news.summary_en: Junior Madi Russ has kept a busy schedule during her time at IU: studying elementary education, competing as an athlete with IU Rowing, and even starting new student organizations, all part of how she’s making the most of her time on campus.

news.title: Introducing the Center for Education Innovation and Entrepreneurship
news.summary_en: The new Center for Education Innovation and Entrepreneurship helps turn innovative ideas into real-world solutions, providing opportunities for students and faculty to put their research and expertise into practice.
